note: Read by claude/bin for the weights and by audit-scribe for the meanings. Bump version only when a change makes audits written before it incomparable to audits written after, never for a reworded meaning.

small.means: One person loses minutes to it, or it is a nuisance nobody has to work around.

moderate.means: Work has to be done differently because of it, and the workaround is known.

large.means: It blocks a change someone will want to make, or it costs a day when it is hit.

severe.means: It loses data, exposes data, or takes the thing down.

now.means: The cost is already being paid at today's size and today's usage.

at-growth.means: The cost arrives when the data or the traffic grows the way it is expected to.

at-scale.means: The cost arrives only well beyond anything this has been asked to handle.
